text:
incident-bot: PAGING: high metering lag detected for `usage-emitter` (consumer lag > 100k msgs). Auto-page sent to #oncall-billing
mike: @oncall-billing seeing early overage flags in billing dashboard, multiple tenants ticking up :grimacing:
jen: oncall here, i'm taking it. will triage. mounting logs now
alex: noticed consumer lag spike starting ~00:07 UTC. producer throughput dropped concurrently
jen: can you run consumer describe? want partition lags and consumer health
alex: pasted output:
```
# kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group usage-emitter-group
# PARTITION 3-9 -> lag ~110k total, throughput -45% over 5m
```
ops-eng: checking emitter replicas: one pod restarted repeatedly since 00:05 UTC, OOMKilled loops
billing: seeing about 10 tenants with auto-overage signals, UI flags up and a handful of email notifications already sent
sara-cs: CS has 4 inbound tickets complaining about unexpected overage emails. customers asking for credits
deploy-bot: Deployment event: `usage-emitter` rolled out at 2026-03-17T00:04:12Z (image: emitter:v3.4.1)
mike: any config changes or sidecar changes in that image?
ops-eng: quick look shows collector sidecar bumped to collector:v1.9 in that rollout. memory footprint for sidecar jumped in metrics
jen: mitigation suggestion: scale emitter pods down to zero then back to N to cut replay cycles, also disable auto billing emails while we reconcile
ops-eng: scaling now -> `kubectl scale deploy/usage-emitter -n prod --replicas=0` then back to 3
ops-eng: also performing `kafka-consumer-groups --reset-offsets --group usage-emitter-group --to-latest` on affected partitions to avoid reprocessing old messages (careful: this may drop late-but-valid events)
billing: hold on offsets reset — if we drop valid late events we need a re-ingest plan. will toggle billing emails off first
billing: flipped feature flag `billing.auto_overage_emails` -> `false` (via admin console). confirmed, emails paused
ops-eng: emitter replicas back to 3, pods stable. sidecar memory back to baseline after we pinned to collector:v1.8 and restarted
jen: starting a live reconciliation query to compare emitted usage vs ledger for the last 40 minutes. Query:
```
SELECT tenant_id, SUM(tokens) AS emitted
FROM usage_emitter_raw
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '40 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
-- will diff against billing.ledger for same window
```
alex: initial diff shows 11 tenants >5% mismatch; 4 tenants have emitted > ledger by 30-80% (possible duplicate processing)
support-bot: prepared holding message for affected tenants: "We're investigating unexpected usage alerts and have temporarily paused automated notifications. We will follow up within 60 minutes with next steps and any credits required." Ready to send once approved
jen: approved. @sara-cs please send and log in incident doc
sara-cs: sent messages to affected customers and filed support tickets. one customer requested immediate credit, tracking that request
billing: running reconciliation dry-run: `recon-service --window 40m --dry-run` -> estimate shows ~14k token overcount across tenants if replays counted twice. Ledger currently authoritative; no customer double-billed yet but UI flags are present
mike: will UI flags clear automatically after ledger recalculation?
billing: flags live until recalculation. queued recalculation job for affected tenant_ids now. ETA ~7m
jen: investigation notes: collector sidecar v1.9 introduced a backpressure handling regression that caused increased memory use -> OOM -> pod restarts -> consumers rebalanced and replayed some batches -> downstream aggregator saw duplicate events
ops-eng: rollback complete, sidecar pinned, memory stable, pods in Ready state. adding liveness/readiness improvements to prevent flapping on future collector errors
jen: handoff: passing to night oncall (@oncall-night) to monitor consumer lag and reconciliation progress. I will be available for 20m for questions
oncall-night: ack. will monitor: - kafka consumer lag threshold 10k - recon job runtime threshold 20m - will reopen paging if thresholds crossed
sara-cs: logging all customer comms and approvals in the incident ticket. prepping post-incident customer note with compensation options if ledger confirms overcount
billing: recon job completed. recalculation removed UI overage flags for 9 tenants. three tenants still need manual audit due to >50% discrepancy. dry-run suggests we should issue credits for ~8k tokens total if we confirm duplication
jen: next steps assigned: - eng-platform to root cause deploy pipeline allowing optional sidecar pinning - eng-ml to review collector memory regression - billing to finalize credits and ledger patches - cs to follow up customers with timeline and credits
incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0317-117. Severity: P2. Handoff complete
mike: quick summary for the handoff: root cause: collector sidecar v1.9 memory regression -> pod restarts -> kafka consumer rebalances -> duplicate processing observed. impact: transient UI overage flags, several customer emails, ~11 tenants affected, potential token overcount ~14k. mitigations: paused auto emails, rolled sidecar back to v1.8, reset/restarted consumers to latest, kicked off reconciliation, CS notified.
jen: thanks team, solid triage and comms. leaving notes in the incident tracker and starting a postmortem doc for root cause and mitigations. close live triage unless oncall-night re-pagers :thumbsup:
